summary.fallback: A worried villager asks you to check on a friend who went deep underground to study zombies by pretending to be one of them.

offer_line.fallback: Excuse me, I need your help. A buddy of mine and I went deep underground a few weeks ago. Zombies were everywhere, so we disguised ourselves as zombies to slip through. Now he spends all his time among them, claiming he is studying them. I worry he may never come back. Please check on him. I can mark the coordinates.

target_line.fallback: Muhhhh. Eughhh. Bwaaaa. Raa-ah, screw it. What do you want?

talk.fallback: Are you the villager's missing friend?
Depends who is asking. If he sent you, then yes, I am probably the fool you came looking for. And no, I am not trapped.
What are you doing down here?
Studying them. Their hunger, their reactions, the way the sickness holds onto a mind. If I can understand it, maybe one day someone can undo it.

spare_choice_label.fallback: I'll leave you to your thing.

attack_return_line.fallback: You... killed him? I need a moment. I have no interest in rewarding you for that. Get out of my sight.

spared_line.fallback: Thank you. I believe I am really onto something here. We might be able to develop a cure for these people one day. Let my friend know I think of him. Please?

post_spare_line.fallback: I am fine. Tell him not to worry.

villager_spared_line.fallback: Well, stranger? I see you have not come back with him. Tell me he is at least doing okay. He is safe? Then that is enough. Thank you for checking on him.
